sourceTitle: Why Nobody Can Afford a House Anymore
title: The Real Reason Houses Won't Get Cheaper
hook: The shortage isn't the main reason prices doubled.
question: Would you give up a 3% rate?

scenes.narration: Everyone blames the housing shortage. It is real, but it is not the whole story.
Yes, America is short about three point eight million homes.
scenes.label: homes short

scenes.narration: But millions of owners are locked in. They hold three percent mortgages, and will not sell into seven percent rates.
That froze an estimated one point seven million home sales. Supply that simply never hit the market.
scenes.label: sales that never happened

scenes.narration: Would you give up a three percent rate? Nobody is.
